findings.title: EKS cluster without secrets encryption
findings.description: Without an encryption_config block, Kubernetes secrets are stored in etcd encrypted only with an AWS-owned key instead of a customer-managed KMS key.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: EKS cluster with public endpoint
findings.description: vpc_config.endpoint_public_access = true exposes the Kubernetes API server to the public internet.

findings.title: EKS cluster without control plane logging
findings.description: Without enabled_cluster_log_types, EKS control-plane audit and authenticator logs are not sent to CloudWatch, blinding incident response.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.
